//: ⚠ THIS `enchantment` OBJECT MUST STAY AT THE TOP OF THIS FILE, AHEAD OF THE ITEM THAT REFERENCES IT.  BN resolves a `relic_data.passive_effects` id at item-load time and objects within one file load in array order, so with the enchantment last the item fails with `invalid enchantment id` (generic_factory.h:462) and the belt silently loses its effect while everything else still loads.  Cost one check-mods run to find.  Do not let a formatter or a tidy-up sort it to the bottom.  (The shield belt used to have a matching ARMOR_* enchantment here; it was replaced on 2026-08-01 by an explicit `resistance` map on the item itself -- see the note on psionic_shield_belt_on.)  ALSO: suppression belt, active.  Heat immunity itself rides on the HEAT_IMMUNE worn flag (see the note on psionic_shield_belt); this covers the other half of upstream's block, DDA `CLIMATE_CONTROL_CHILL: 1000` -> BN `CLIMATE_CONTROL_COOLING`.  BN splits climate control into COOLING/HEATING suffixes where DDA used CHILL/WARMTH; COOLING is the one that keeps you comfortable in heat.  1000 is upstream's value, half of what BN power armor grants (power_armor.json:97, `add: 2000`), which is the right shape for a belt that only fights heat.

BELT PROTECTION -- restored 2026-08-01.  Both belts arrived from DDA with their entire `passive_effects` block dropped (DDA relic system; the leftover `//relic` marker on each item is the tombstone), leaving two 2-encumbrance belts that toggled an LED, drained a battery and did NOTHING else.  Rebuilt on BN-native mechanisms.  Three things did NOT survive as written and are deliberately re-expressed: (1) `TELEKIN_SHIELD` is a MoM-invented flag BN has never heard of -- zero hits in CBN/src and CBN/data -- because upstream implements it through DDA custom damage types, which BN lacks; (2) the ported effect `effect_suppression_belt_fire_protection` carries the flag `HEAT_IMMUNE`, but on an EFFECT BN wants `EFFECT_HEAT_IMMUNE` -- bare `HEAT_IMMUNE` is the WORN ITEM flag (character.cpp:7176-7177), so the effect route was inert twice over; (3) DDA's `CLIMATE_CONTROL_CHILL` is `CLIMATE_CONTROL_COOLING` in BN.  Both effects are left defined in gen_effects.json but are no longer the delivery mechanism -- the immunities now ride on worn item flags, which is how BN natively does `is_immune_damage` (character.cpp:7150-7185).  Enchantment sign convention verified: armor_enchantment_adjust does `du.amount += bonus` (character.cpp:9124-9130), so a NEGATIVE add reduces damage, matching DDA's incoming_damage_mod -- upstream's numbers carry over verbatim.
description: A simple synthetic fabric belt with a box to the right of the belt loop.  The box has a toggleable switch and a stylized shield with Ψ and the XEDRA logo inside it, beside a raised club struck through with a large circle and line.  Switched on, it thickens the air against your skin until blunt force simply cannot reach you -- but the same treacle drags on every movement you make, and it is far less use against a blade or a bullet.  The field is hungry, and eats a charged battery quickly.

use_action.msg: You flip the switch on the belt and it emits a resonant thump.  The space just outside the surface of your body feels as thick as molasses.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The switch clicks but nothing happens.

use_action.msg: You flip the switch on the box and the red LED turns off.

//: Active state is a FIELD, not a garment: it thickens the space just outside the skin, so it covers the whole body, stops blunt force almost absolutely, and drags on everything you do.  Encumbrance 80 on six part groups is far beyond any vanilla armour (BN's heaviest sheet is 15) and is the deliberate price.  Resistances use BN's explicit `resistance` map (item_factory.cpp:2039, keys bash/cut/stab/bullet -- damage.cpp:540-547; BN calls the player's `pierce` STAB).  bash 100 is off the top of the vanilla scale on purpose -- BN's best ballistic plate is bullet 90 -- and it REPLACES the earlier BASH_IMMUNE flag: same intent, but a number that armour-piercing can still bite into rather than a binary the game cannot tune.  `resistance` also replaced the ARMOR_* enchantment, so ench_mom_shield_belt is gone; the suppression belt keeps its own.  EYES and MOUTH are deliberately NOT covered: encumbrance there drives vision and breathing penalties rather than movement, and 80 would blind the wearer -- add them only if that is wanted.

description: A simple synthetic fabric belt with a box to the right of the belt loop.  The box has a toggleable switch and a stylized flame with a large circle and line superimposed over it and a Ψ behind the XEDRA logo inside it.  Switched on, it holds a shell of cool air against your skin: fire cannot burn you at all, and even a blazing room stays bearable.  It sips at its battery while lit.

use_action.msg: You flip the switch on the box and a red LED lights up.
use_action.need_charges_msg: The switch clicks but nothing happens.

use_action.msg: You flip the switch on the box and the red LED turns off.
